title.zh: THORChain 拒绝 Bitget 及 SlowMist 冻结黑客地址的请求
title.en: THORChain refuses Bitget and SlowMist requests to block hacker-linked addresses

current_state.zh: THORChain拒绝了Bitget和安全公司SlowMist的正式请求，该请求要求其拒绝为与该交易所超过3.8亿美元黑客事件相关的地址提供服务。四个月前，THORChain在自身遭遇1000万美元漏洞攻击后暂停了交易。
current_state.en: THORChain declined a formal request from Bitget and security firm SlowMist to refuse service to addresses linked to the exchange's over $380 million hack, four months after THORChain paused trading following its own $10 million exploit.

updates.title_en: THORChain Rejects Request to Block Bitget Addresses Amid Exploit Fallout - Intellectia AI
updates.what_changed_zh: THORChain在漏洞事件后拒绝了封锁Bitget相关地址的请求，该网络的决定凸显了其拒绝应交易所或第三方要求审查交易的立场。
updates.what_changed_en: THORChain rejected a request to block Bitget-related addresses in the wake of an exploit, with the network's decision highlighting its refusal to censor transactions at the request of an exchange or third party.
